$sources: NBR 15421:2006 6.1-6.3 (zones and ag, site classes, Ca and Cv), 6.3 (the design spectrum), 8-9 (categories, the equivalent lateral force method: Cs, the period, Cup), Table 6 (R, Ω0, Cd: the base pack's ASCE 7 numbers); see VERIFY.md
source: NBR 15421:2006: ags0 = Ca ag, ags1 = Cv ag; Sa = ags0 (18.75 T Ca/Cv + 1) up to 0.08 Cv/Ca, 2.5 ags0 to 0.4 Cv/Ca, ags1/T beyond, i.e. the base pack's two-period spectrum with SDS = 2.5 ags0 and SD1 = ags1 (SS = 2.5 ag, S1 = ag, Fa = Ca, Fv = Cv, designShare 1); Cs = 2.5 ags0/(R/I) ≤ ags1/(T R/I), at least 0.01; the rest of the seismic rules the base pack's

SA.description: Class A: hard rock (vs above 1500 m/s)

SC.description: Class C: very dense soil and soft rock (vs 370-760 m/s, N above 50)

SD.description: Class D: stiff soil (vs 180-370 m/s, N 15-50)

SE.description: Class E: soft soil (vs below 180 m/s, N below 15)

SF.description: Class F: soils needing a site-specific study

siteCoefficients.clause: NBR 15421 6.3, Table 3 (Ca at ag ≤ 0.10 and 0.15, written at SS = 2.5 ag; Cv at ag)

clauses.design: NBR 15421 6.3 (ags0 = Ca ag, ags1 = Cv ag)
clauses.sdc: NBR 15421 7.3.1, Table 4 (seismic categories by zone; SAEngine's bands: VERIFY.md B8)
clauses.cs: NBR 15421 9.1 (Cs = 2.5 ags0 / (g R/I) ≤ ags1 / (g T R/I), at least 0.01)

siteSpecificStudy.warning: Site class {classes}: {code} {clause} requires a site-specific study. Until one is made, Ca and Cv are those of class {assumed}: an assumption, not a value of the standard.

sources.siteClasses: NBR 15421 Table 2: classes A-F by the average shear wave speed (or N) of the top 30 m
sources.designSpectrum.designShare: NBR 15421 6.3: no 2/3 (ag is the design value)
sources.designSpectrum.csLimits: NBR 15421 9.1: Cs at least 0.01 (no 0.044 SDS term)
sources.designSpectrum.periodUpper: NBR 15421 Table 9: Cup 1.7 (zone 2), 1.6 (zone 3), 1.5 (zone 4), here by SD1 (= ag on class B)
sources.designCategories: SAEngine practice: NBR 15421 Table 4 gives category A in zones 0-1 (only 0.01 W at each level), B in zone 2, C in zones 3-4; the bands of SDS = 2.5 Ca ag and SD1 = Cv ag at 0.125 / 0.25 and 0.05 / 0.10 g read them for class B; SAEngine's categories B, B, C (category A is analysed as B, on the safe side)
